product_family: AI-powered writing assistant (paraphrasing, rewriting, grammar/tone correction, summarization, translation) offered as a free/premium web app, browser extension, and mobile app; also sold as Wordtune for Business/Enterprise (adds a 'Traceless Model' privacy option) and exposed to developers as a Wordtune API through AI21 Studio. Wordtune is owned and operated by AI21 Labs Ltd, the Israeli company behind the Jamba/Jurassic LLM family and AI21 Studio.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: we are proud to announce that AI21 Labs has successfully completed the SOC 2 audit report (report type/date not stated on the page). NOTE: this announcement is on AI21 Labs' corporate domain and never names Wordtune; Wordtune's own privacy policy, terms of use, business terms, and FAQ make no mention of SOC 2.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: AI21 Labs achieved ISO 27001, ISO 27017, and ISO 27018 certifications. NOTE: same corporate-domain-only caveat as SOC 2 above - Wordtune product pages do not reference this certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (cloud security)
certifications.proof_quote: AI21 Labs achieved ISO 27001, ISO 27017, and ISO 27018 certifications. Same scope caveat as ISO 27001 above.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (PII in cloud)
certifications.proof_quote: AI21 Labs achieved ISO 27001, ISO 27017, and ISO 27018 certifications. Same scope caveat as ISO 27001 above.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on wordtune.com or ai21.com of an ISO 42001 certification.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR registration or certification for Wordtune or AI21 Labs.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Users are contractually barred from submitting sensitive categories: 'do not submit health information, financial account details, passwords, or government ID numbers' (paraphrase of Section 5.4 restriction). No BAA or HIPAA claim exists anywhere on wordtune.com.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No PCI DSS claim found; payment processing is delegated to third-party processors (Stripe, Chargeflow) listed as sub-processors in the privacy policy, so card data does not appear to be handled directly by Wordtune.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; not applicable to this consumer/SMB writing tool.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Wordtune will comply with GDPR transfer rules, including by implementing transfer mechanisms such as executing Standard Contractual Clauses with the data recipient and/or relying on their Data Privacy Framework certification.

privacy.ai_training_note: Consumer tier: Terms of Use grant Wordtune a 'nonexclusive, worldwide, royalty-free and fully-paid, transferable and sub-licensable, perpetual, and irrevocable license' to submitted content, usable to 'improve the algorithms underlying the Software'; users can only opt out of aggregated/de-identified use by emailing privacy@wordtune.com. Business tier: default plan lets 'Wordtune use the Input and Output on an anonymized basis to train its algorithms and improve the Service quality'; customers can instead purchase the 'Traceless Model,' under which 'all Input and Output will be automatically deleted a few seconds after generation, ensuring that Wordtune neither stores nor utilizes it for training.' No standalone customer-facing DPA was found publicly; the privacy policy only describes an internal intra-group data processing agreement covering transfers within the AI21 group.
privacy.data_region: Primary processing/storage in the United States; cross-border transfers from EEA/UK/Switzerland covered by Standard Contractual Clauses and/or EU-US Data Privacy Framework reliance.

security.name: Encryption in transit/at rest
security.value: Not specified in public documentation - only a generic statement that the company has 'implemented appropriate technical, organizational and security measures designed to protect your Personal Data.' No TLS/encryption-at-rest detail is published.

security.name: AI training opt-out
security.value: Consumer: opt-out limited to aggregated/de-identified use via emailing privacy@wordtune.com; default license otherwise permits use of content to improve algorithms. Business: 'Traceless Model' add-on disables storage and training entirely; the default business plan trains on anonymized input/output.

security.name: Cross-border data transfer mechanism
security.value: Standard Contractual Clauses and/or reliance on the recipient's EU-US Data Privacy Framework certification.

security.name: Sensitive data restriction
security.value: Terms of Use prohibit submitting health information, financial account details, passwords, or government ID numbers.

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Personal data is stored until proactively deleted by Wordtune or a valid deletion request is received, subject to legal/litigation holds.

security.name: Parent-entity certifications (corporate scope)
security.value: AI21 Labs Ltd - the legal entity that operates Wordtune per Wordtune's own Terms of Use - publicly states it holds SOC 2 and ISO 27001/27017/27018 certifications and runs a corporate Trust Center at trust.ai21.com. These are corporate-level claims on ai21.com; no Wordtune-specific document confirms the Wordtune product/infrastructure is within the certified scope.

products.name: Wordtune (Free/Premium, consumer)
products.category: Individual AI writing assistant (web app, browser extension, mobile app)
products.data_scope: User-submitted text (documents, emails, messages); broad perpetual license granted to Wordtune for service delivery and algorithm improvement
products.notes: Default plan trains on user content per Terms of Use; opt-out only for aggregated/de-identified use via email request. No cert claims on this tier.

products.name: Wordtune for Business/Enterprise
products.category: Team/organization AI writing assistant with admin controls
products.data_scope: Same as consumer by default (anonymized training) unless the 'Traceless Model' add-on is purchased, which deletes input/output within seconds and excludes it from training
products.notes: Only tier where AI21 offers a documented no-training/no-retention mode ('Traceless Model'); this is the tier most likely to matter for buyers with strict data-handling requirements.

products.name: Wordtune API (via AI21 Studio)
products.category: Developer API access to the models behind Wordtune (paraphrase, grammar correction, text improvement, segmentation, summarization)
products.data_scope: Developer-submitted API payloads processed through AI21 Studio infrastructure
products.notes: Distributed through AI21 Studio rather than wordtune.com; falls under AI21's Studio/API terms rather than the consumer Wordtune Terms of Use.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium subscription (free tier + paid Premium for individuals; separate paid Business/Enterprise plans with per-seat pricing and an optional 'Traceless Model' privacy add-on)
compare.data_residency: US-based processing/storage; SCC/DPF-based transfer mechanisms for EEA/UK/Swiss users
top_certs: SOC 2 (parent entity AI21 Labs Ltd, corporate scope - not confirmed Wordtune-specific)
ISO 27001 / 27017 / 27018 (parent entity AI21 Labs Ltd, corporate scope - not confirmed Wordtune-specific)

flags: SOC 2 and ISO 27001/27017/27018 certifications are announced only on AI21 Labs' corporate domain (ai21.com) and are never tied to Wordtune by name; Wordtune's own privacy policy, terms of use, business terms of use, and FAQ contain no mention of any certification. AI21 Labs Ltd is confirmed, via Wordtune's own Terms of Use, to be the entity operating Wordtune, so these certifications apply at the corporate level; buyers should not assume Wordtune-specific product infrastructure was within the audit scope without confirming with AI21.
No dedicated Wordtune trust center exists; AI21's trust.ai21.com is a corporate trust center for the AI21 Labs entity, not a Wordtune-branded page.

Consumer tier trains on user content by default via a broad perpetual license in the Terms of Use; the only documented no-training path (the 'Traceless Model') is a paid Business/Enterprise add-on, not available to free or Premium individual users.
No evidence of a self-serve, customer-facing Data Processing Agreement; only an internal AI21-group intra-group DPA is documented.
